newsitem.title: UK: Eurobond trade ideas - EIB switch in sterling.
newsitem.headline: Eurobond trade ideas - EIB switch in sterling.

text.p: Eurobond analysts' latest trade recommendations focused on sterling, dollars, lire and yen.
Following are latest trade ideas, compiled by Reuters:

STRATEGY This move results in a yield give-up of 32 basis points which is only 5 b.p. below the 1997 high of -27 b.p. The lower coupon on the buy side means that an investor can buy the two-year bond at a discount to par, while selling the five-year bond at a premium to par.
STRATEGY This switch gives a pick-up of 30 b.p. with a recent average being 23.5 b.p.

STRATEGY The sell side of this switch has outperformed the buy side by approximately 145 b.p. in price terms in the last few months. The World Bank 9.45 percent bond is cheaper against the swap and BTP, is shorter in duration and offers around a 28 b.p. pick-up in yield.

STRATEGY The Abbey National 9.40 pct bond has in the last few months underperformed the Abbey National 7.625 pct bond by approximately 115 b.p. in price terms, it is also cheaper against the swap and BTP and offers a pick up value against the swap curve of +32 b.p.

STRATEGY This switch offers a yield pick-up but a one notch drop in credit rating. With both issuers having legal support under the electricity utility law of Japan it could be argued that their ultimate creditworthiness is the same.

STRATEGY Early in the year a large number of three-year and four-year retail targeted deals were brought to the market. To date the better performance has come from the long three-year deals but spreads have now tightened to a level where a switch longer makes sense. Both the above switches result in yield pick-ups and the move out of Bayerische Hypo also gives a pick-up in credit.
